title: OutcomeBound ticket store declaration v1
description: The `.outcomebound/tickets.json` a project declares its ticket store in. The bounded repository-relative path grammar of `claims` is checked after this, by the engine's one path reader. The declaration changes what the engine can report and never makes the engine act anywhere.

version.description: Exactly 1. A version this engine does not read is refused before anything else here is looked at.

store.description: Which store holds the tickets: the `github` tracker, read from an export.

repo.description: owner/project, as the tracker spells it. The layer is one repository, and a relation naming another is never taken for a local one, so a name that is not owner/project would silently match nothing.

label.description: The label that makes an issue a ticket. Applying it is the user's acceptance, and no later edit lapses it.

human_label.description: A person's hold on a ticket.

request_label.description: An agent's request that a person take the ticket.

claims.description: Bounded repository-relative path of one v1 validation plan, so claim names are one namespace.

default_branch.description: An optional ref name. It is accepted and no verb reads it.

writes.description: The operator's grant of tracker writes for this project. Without it the skills print the tracker commands for a person to run.

granted_by.description: The operator who granted tracker writes.

on.description: When the grant was given; the commit that adds it records the grant.
